::: {#sol-three-k-plus-two}

**$17 \in T$.**
An element of $T$ is a number of the form $3k + 2$ with $k$ an integer.
Take $k = 5$, which is an integer.
Then $3k + 2 = 3 \cdot 5 + 2 = 17$, so $17 \in T$.

**$19 \notin T$.**
Suppose, for contradiction, that $19 \in T$ (@def-proof-by-contradiction).
Then $19 = 3k + 2$ for some integer $k$.
Subtracting 2 from both sides gives $3k = 17$, so $k = 17/3$.
But $17/3$ is not an integer, since $3 \cdot 5 = 15 < 17 < 18 = 3 \cdot 6$.
This contradicts that $k$ is an integer, so $19 \notin T$.

:::
